title: Habitat classification from ground-level imagery using deep neural networks
why: A single ground-level photograph is enough to place a site into one of 18 fine-grained UKHab classes at 71.5% top-1 — comparable to the strongest of three experienced ecologists on the same held-out photographs.

title: Federated learning with workload reduction through partial training of client models and entropy-based data selection
why: Attacks client-side training cost from both ends at once — training only part of the model, on only the data worth training on — instead of trading one saving for the other.
